ai.description: *Nanorana minica* is a small frog reaching 25–30 mm. It is brown with dark dorsal spots and a pale mid-dorsal stripe. Key features include a smooth belly and distinct, enlarged femoral glands.
ai.identificationRemarks: *Nanorana minica* is best distinguished by the presence of prominent, black-tipped spines on the chest and throat of breeding males, which are absent in similar *Nanorana* species.
ai.habitat: *Nanorana minica* inhabits high-altitude streams and moist rocky areas within temperate forests and alpine meadows, typically ranging from 1,500 to 3,000 meters in elevation.
ai.behavior: The Small Paa Frog is primarily nocturnal and utilizes its camouflaged skin to blend into rocky stream beds, where it remains motionless to ambush passing insect prey.
ai.reproductionNotes: *Nanorana minica* is an oviparous frog that breeds during the monsoon (June–August). It lays small clutches of eggs attached to submerged rocks in mountain streams.
ai.distributionRemarks: *Nanorana minica* is found in the Himalayan regions of Himachal Pradesh, Uttarakhand, and Nepal, typically inhabiting high-altitude streams between 1,500 and 3,000 meters.
ai.callDescription: The advertisement call of *Nanorana minica* consists of a series of short, high-pitched "peep" notes, typically heard near small, slow-moving streams in forest habitats.
